cohort: Primiparous women in the Netherlands who gave birth to term singleton infants through planned or emergency caesarean section and had a second singleton delivery.
finding: Women with a planned caesarean in their first birth had a moderately increased risk of postpartum haemorrhage and a small to moderately increased risk of uterine rupture and stillbirth in their second birth compared to women with an emergency caesarean in their first birth.
mod_finding: Women with a history of a planned caesarean section in their first birth had a slightly increased risk of uterine rupture in their second birth compared to women with a history of an emergency caesarean section.
